raw.details:
About the Competition:

CodeNeuraX presents NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026, in collaboration with the Department of AI, ML & DS, Marwadi University — an offline web development challenge designed to test participants' web development skills, creativity, problem-solving ability, technical implementation, and ability to build practical solutions.

The competition is open to college and university students across India. Three problem statements will be provided by the organizers, and each participant can choose any one problem statement to solve. The problem statements will be revealed live by the organizers at 12:00 AM (midnight) on the final offline round date. Participants will then compete offline at Marwadi University, where they will have 7 hours to develop, test, refine, and present their final solution.

Competition Details:

  • Event: NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026
  • Organizer: CodeNeuraX
  • In Collaboration With: Department of AI, ML & DS, Marwadi University
  • Final Offline Round Date: To Be Announced Soon
  • Mode: Offline
  • Venue: Marwadi University
  • Competition Time: To Be Announced Soon
  • Duration: 7 Hours
  • Participation: Individual
  • Number of Problem Statements: 3
  • Choice: Participants can choose any 1 problem statement
  • Registration Fee: ₹99

Problem Statements:

  • There will be 3 problem statements for the competition.
  • All three problem statements will be provided by the organizers.
  • Each participant must choose any one problem statement to solve.
  • Participants will compete individually on their selected problem statement.
  • The problem statements will be revealed live by the organizers at 12:00 AM (midnight) on the final offline round date.
  • Participants can review the three problem statements before reporting to the venue.
  • The official 7-hour competition window will begin at the announced start time.
  • Participants will use the 7-hour window to develop, test, refine, and present their solution.

Competition Process:

  • Participants register individually for NEURA KNOCKOUT 2026.
  • Three problem statements will be revealed live by the organizers at 12:00 AM on the final offline round date.
  • Participants review all three problem statements and choose any one.
  • Participants report to Marwadi University for the offline competition.
  • The official competition begins at the announced start time.
  • Participants receive 7 hours to develop, test, refine, and prepare their solution.
  • Participants may use permitted AI tools, agents, frameworks, libraries, and development resources.
  • Participants must complete their web-based solution within the competition duration.
  • Participants must present/demo their final solution within the allotted 7-hour window.
  • The evaluation panel will assess the solutions and presentations.
  • Winners will be selected based on the overall evaluation.
  • Results will be announced by the organizers after completion of the evaluation process.

Rules:

  • Participation is strictly individual. Team participation is not permitted.
  • Three problem statements will be provided, and each participant must choose any one to solve.
  • The problem statements will be revealed at 12:00 AM on the final offline round date.
  • Participants may choose only one problem statement for their submission.
  • The official development and presentation schedule will be announced by the organizers.
  • Participants must complete and present their solution within the allotted 7 hours.
  • Participants are permitted to use AI tools, AI agents, coding assistants, libraries, frameworks, documentation, and other development tools.
  • Participants must not submit plagiarized or copied work from another participant.
  • Impersonation or submission of work belonging to another person is strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must not intentionally disrupt the competition, venue infrastructure, network, systems, or other participants.
  • Any form of cheating, unfair practice, or violation of competition instructions may result in disqualification.
  • Participants may be asked to demonstrate or explain their implementation to the evaluation panel.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring that their submitted solution is functional and ready for evaluation.
  • Participants must follow all instructions provided by the organizers and venue authorities.
  • The decision of the organizing and evaluation committee regarding the results will be final.
  • The organizers reserve the right to modify the competition procedure or schedule if required due to unforeseen circumstances.

Registration Fee:

₹99 per participant

Prizes:

  • First Prize: ₹2,100
  • Second Prize: ₹1,500
  • Third Prize: ₹1,100

Premium goodies may be provided to top performers, and certificates will be provided to all participants.
